shiftid.title: Shift
shiftid.remarks: The shift record to which this log entry belongs.

entrytime.title: Entry Created
entrytime.remarks: The time and date when this entry was created.

originatingid.title: Originating Entry
originatingid.remarks: The entry to which the current entry applies if the current entry is a follow-up or correction.

eventtime.title: Event Time
eventtime.remarks: The time and date when the event in this entry occurred.

entrytype.title: Entry Type
entrytype.remarks: The type or purpose of this narrative log entry.

comporig.title: Completes Originating Entry
comporig.remarks: Indicates whether the current entry completes the originating entry. This check box is automatically selected when you use the Complete Originating Entry button to create a follow-up entry. The check box cannot be manually selected or cleared.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Identifies the site to which the shift record applies.

tempentryid.title: Narrative Log Template
tempentryid.remarks: The identifier of the duplicated narrative log template.

ticketid.title: Condition Report
ticketid.remarks: The condition report that is related to this entry. You can click the Create/Relate Condition Report icon to create a condition report or relate an existing condition report.

userunit.title: Unit
userunit.remarks: The unit of the person who created this entry.

entrysummary.title: Event Details
entrysummary.remarks: A short description of the event that is documented in this entry.

revisionnum.title: Revision
revisionnum.remarks: The revision of the duty station plan.

entryby.title: Created By
entryby.remarks: The person who created this entry.

priority.title: Priority
priority.remarks: The priority of this entry relative to other open entries in the narrative log.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organzation to which this entry applies.

ticketclass.title: Class
ticketclass.remarks: Class of the ticket. Default values are SR (service request), INCIDENT, and PROBLEM.

corrected.title: Correction Status
corrected.remarks: Indicates whether the current entry corrects or is corrected by another entry. In both cases, the value is automatically defined.

followup.title: Follow-Up Status
followup.remarks: If the current entry is new, specify whether it requires follow-up action. If the current entry is not new, the value in this field is automatically defined and indicates whether the required follow-up action is pending (REQD), in progress, or complete.

unit.title: Unit
unit.remarks: Identifies the unit to which the shift record applies.

isowner.title: Shift Owner
isowner.remarks: Indicates whether the person who created this entry is the owner or an editor of the shift record for the specified function.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: The location that is associated with the  narrative log template for the duty station.

position.title: Function
position.remarks: The function of the person who created this entry. The function is derived from active shift records to which the person has shift owner or editor access. Shift records that have a common log are excluded from the evaluation.

stationid.title: Duty Station Plan
stationid.remarks: Identifies the duty station plan on which the shift record is based.
